name: Traditional Green Bean Casserole with Crispy Fried Onions & Mushroom Soup (Flare Avoid)
whyItWorks: A classic holiday side that combines three common Crohn's triggers: fibrous string beans, high-FODMAP fried onions/mushrooms, and heavy dairy cream.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip Green Bean Casserole during flares or cautious days and fill your plate with mashed potatoes, sweet potato casserole, glazed carrots, and turkey instead.
watchOuts: French's crispy fried onions (fructans + fryer oil)
Tough green bean fibers and mushrooms
